description_excerpt: NVIDIA Networking Engineering group is looking for a hardworking Senior NPI Infrastructure Engineer for a full-time position, on-site at our Foxconn Vietnam (FXV) manufacturing facility in Bac Ninh Province. The responsibility of this position is quality control and readiness verification of production infrastructure arriving at the site, ensuring test and assembly infrastructure meets NVIDIA's standards ahead of and throughout production ramp. You will be the local extension of the NPI Infrastructure team, working closely with Israel-based teams and CM suppliers. A wonderful place to work…
